title: Using the activity view to see changes to a repository

steps.quote: On GitHub, navigate to the main page of the repository.
steps.text: On GitHub, navigate to the main page of the repository.
steps.goal: The repository's main page is open
steps.skip_reason: Covered by the start URL (the repository's main page).

steps.quote: On the main page of the repository, to the right of the list of files, click **Activity**.
steps.text: On the main page of the repository, to the right of the list of files, click Activity.
steps.goal: The repository's activity view, listing pushes and merges, is visible

steps.quote: To filter by activity type, select the **All activity** dropdown menu, then click an activity type.
steps.text: To filter by activity type, select the All activity dropdown menu, then click an activity type.
steps.goal: A menu of activity types is open
